# Pull Request Checklist

## Summary

Describe the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Correct architectural layer owns the behavior.
- [ ] Tests added or updated.
- [ ] Incremental/full rebuild equivalence considered.
- [ ] Output remains deterministic.
- [ ] Errors are actionable.
- [ ] Public API impact reviewed.
- [ ] Performance impact measured if hot path changed.
- [ ] Docs updated.
- [ ] No adapter-specific semantics leaked into core.
- [ ] No new unsafe code, or unsafe code is documented and tested.

## Compatibility impact

None / additive / breaking.

## Benchmark notes

If applicable, include before/after results.
